sessions.intent: Research whether PLang should build its own mail server (C# SMTP module + PLang goals) vs relay, and hand a brief to the architect.

before.assumptions: Working branch is main (v0.1.x line, PLang/Modules/...), not runtime2. main has no email module; message.SendEmail routes to an Email app calling email.plang.io. Ingi's list of requirements: custom domain, thousands/day outbound via API, inbound with retention, websocket push, identity-based addressing (1 real email -> many identities). Start time is the moment this file was first written, after the first reading pass.
before.risk: Outbound deliverability is the hard part and is not a code problem. Scaleway pages returned 403 to the fetcher, so Scaleway facts come from search summaries and need verification before they are relied on.

actions.context: Read main to establish what mail, websocket and push code exists: no email module, send seam via message.SendEmail -> Email app, server websocket stubbed, identity-keyed poll stream is the working push.
MTA options, Google/Yahoo/Microsoft rules, SES enforcement and pricing, Hetzner/Scaleway ports, AgentMail limits. Each fact tagged read / search / internal. Scaleway is search-summary only (403).

Brief for the architect: own inbound, relay outbound. Alternatives considered: wrap Stalwart as sidecar (kept as fallback), webhook-based inbound from a provider, AgentMail (rejected on per-inbox price and retention).
Architect (architect/mail-server) was not in ListAgents, so no message was sent; Ingi is told the start command instead.

after.status: Brief written and indexed as handed-over; architect not running, so not yet delivered.
after.notes: Open: verify Scaleway TEM price/quota/port wording on scaleway.com; confirm what email.plang.io is; Hetzner FAQ page is dated 2024-09-12.
